info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Limits-v3-spec
info.description: The List Credit Card Application Limits API allows users to retrieve the current limits imposed on credit card applications. This endpoint provides insights into the thresholds that govern how many applications can be submitted, enabling financial institutions and developers to manage their application processes effectively. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and credit management platforms looking to ensure compliance with lending regulations. By monitoring these limits, organizations can optimize their application handling and improve their service offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current limit of applications allowed within the system. This can be useful for understanding quotas and resource allocation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to define the parameters for retrieving the limit on applications. It should be formatted in JSON and adhere to the defined schema.
